The claim states that the evidence supports an opacity value alpha in [0, 1] for each voxel. The evidence explicitly states that for color data sets, 'the classification function is only used to assign opacity since each voxel has an RGB color associated with it.' While the evidence does not explicitly use the symbol '$alpha$' or the interval '$[0, 1]$', in the context of volume rendering and classification functions described (assigning opacity based on classification), opacity values are universally defined within the range [0, 1] (0 being fully transparent, 1 being fully opaque). The evidence confirms that the system assigns an opacity value to each voxel. Therefore, the core fact that an opacity value is assigned to each voxel is supported.

This confirms that the method addresses the specified difficulty.
